response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg_diff FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg_diff AS diff_minus_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg_diff IS NOT NULL
